system.description:
Administration is the skill of running a business or organization. This skill is primarily used to recover taxed Resources.

Obstacles: Just you, Ob 1. A shop, Ob 2. Confraternity, Ob 3. Small commune, Ob 4. Small guild, Ob 5. Small secret society, Ob 6. Large secret society, Ob 7. Small trading concern, Ob 8. Large guild, Ob 9. Giant trading concern, Ob 10.

Skill Type: Special. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 253
